:::{#thm-risk-decomposition}
#### Squared-error risk decomposition

Let $\truemeanf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$ be the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$.
For any [prediction function](#def-prediction) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ with $\E{\predfnf{\Predvar}^2} < \infty$:

$$\popriskf{\predfn} = \popriskf{\truemean} + \E{\sqf{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}}$$

:::

::: proof

The steps use
the [squared-error risk](#def-squared-error-risk) definition,
@lem-prediction-error-split,
@lem-cross-term-zero,
and @thm-linearity-expectation:

$$
\ba
\popriskf{\predfn}
&= \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\predfn}}}
&& \text{(definition of the squared-error risk)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\truemean} + \devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}}}
&& \text{(the prediction error splits at } \truemean \text{)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\truemean}}}
+ 2 \cd \E{\prederrf{\truemean} \cd \devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}}
+ \E{\sqf{\devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}}}
&& \text{(expand the square; linearity of expectation)} \\
&= \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\truemean}}}
+ 2 \cd 0
+ \E{\sqf{\devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}}}
&& \text{(the cross term is } 0 \text{)} \\
&= \popriskf{\truemean}
+ \E{\sqf{\devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}}}
&& \text{(definition of the squared-error risk of } \truemean \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-risk-decomposition}
#### The risk decomposition in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
the constant [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$ has [squared-error risk](#def-squared-error-risk) $\popriskf{\predfn_1} = 5$,
which @thm-risk-decomposition splits as $5 = 1 + 4$:
the risk $1$ of the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) plus the excess $4$ from using $\predfn_1$.

:::
